title: fix: update MIDI Journey 2 catalog name and screenshot
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Corrected the existing app catalog entry to say MIDI Journey 2 and use the maintainer-selected Ableton screenshot. Updated the generated README listing; the original artwork remains in the MIDI Journey repository. The catalog image is a 1280×720 WebP.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art music studio, Polli wears tiny headphones and hovers beside a retro monitor showing a chunky MIDI piano roll for MIDI Journey 2; a small code-plant grows beside the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized, sharing the frame with the monitor, never oversized or dominating the image; strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
